name: National General Cleaning Corp
language_note: All real, first-party text found (Instagram bio, Instagram post graphics, BBB profile, miamidirections.com listing, the Google Business Site) is in English. No Spanish text was found anywhere in the business's own materials, despite the owners having Hispanic names and operating in a heavily Hispanic area (Miami Lakes). Per the 'confirm with real evidence, don't assume' rule, language = en.
owner_source: BBB Business Profile (bbb.org/us/fl/miami-lakes/profile/cleaning-services/national-general-cleaning-corp-0633-90594923), which explicitly sources this from the Florida Division of Corporations (Sunbiz) filing. Direct WebFetch to search.sunbiz.org returned HTTP 403 (blocked, consistent with prior sessions' experience), so BBB's citation of the Sunbiz filing is used instead of a direct Sunbiz fetch.
founded_note: BBB: 'Business started: 6/1/2016', 'Business incorporated: 6/1/2016', 'Years in Business: 10', Entity Type: Corporation. The business's own Instagram graphic (a July 4th holiday post, ig-1.jpg) independently shows their logo badge reading 'National General Cleaning · Since 2016', self-corroborating the BBB date.
phone_source: Confirmed identically across 4 independent sources: task brief, BBB profile, live Google Maps listing (WebFetch-rendered via scripts/gmaps_verify.js, 'Open 24 hours \n +1 786-718-2426'), and the business's own Instagram bio text ('Contact us: (786) 718-2426', recovered via a Google search snippet of the profile page). A different phone (305-690-8585) appeared on a low-quality aggregator (whosmypro.com) for the same street address; not used, since it directly conflicts with 4 independently-corroborated sources for the real number.
email_note: No public email found after checking: BBB profile (only offers an internal 'Email this business' contact-form widget, no address exposed), the Google Business Site at national-general-cleaning-corp.business.site (returns HTTP 404, unpublished/broken), Instagram bio (recovered via search-engine snippet: 'Commercial Services · Guaranteed Services · 100% Quality · Facebook: National General Cleaning Corp · Twitter: @NationalCorp · Contact us: (786) 718-2426' -- no email listed), Facebook (facebook.com/p/National-General-Cleaning-Corp-100063885917602/, blocked by a hard login wall for every User-Agent tried: facebookexternalhit/1.1, Facebot, WhatsApp, and a full Chrome UA, both via curl and WebFetch -- consistently 302/404 to the Facebook login page, could not read About/Contact), X/Twitter (x.com/NationalCorp, WebFetch returned HTTP 402 Payment Required), miamidirections.com listing (no email field), and general web search (no email surfaced anywhere).
address_source: Identical across BBB ('7345 Fairway Dr Apt 508, Miami Lakes, FL 33014-6869'), live Google Maps (scripts/gmaps_verify.js: '7345 Fairway Dr Apt 508, Miami Lakes, FL 33014, United States', plus code WM7J+27 Miami Lakes, statusLine OPEN_LISTED), and the task brief. Note: a separate aggregator (miamidirections.com) lists the SAME street address under 'Hialeah, FL' in its title/URL while its own body text says 'Miami Lakes, Florida' -- this is that aggregator's own inconsistency, not evidence the business is in Hialeah. Google Maps (the authoritative live source) and BBB both agree on Miami Lakes, FL 33014, which is used.
address_note: This is an apartment unit (Apt 508), i.e. a home-based / mobile commercial cleaning operation with no public storefront, consistent with a small owner-operated commercial cleaning crew that goes to client sites (warehouses, offices) rather than receiving walk-in customers. Per the task's own guidance for a residential/apartment address, the site does NOT show a street-level map pin on the apartment; the contact section uses a city-level 'Miami Lakes, FL' map embed instead (https://www.google.com/maps?q=Miami+Lakes%2C+FL&output=embed'), treating it as their service area rather than publishing a private home address as if it were a storefront.
hours_source: Live Google Maps listing (scripts/gmaps_verify.js rawSnippet literally shows 'Open 24 hours' directly under the address/phone). No other source gives specific weekday hours. Plausible for a commercial/facility cleaning crew that works off-hours shifts (warehouses/offices are typically cleaned overnight or after business hours), consistent with the 'Commercial Services' positioning found in their own Instagram bio.
rating_source: Rating of 5.0 independently reconfirmed LIVE in this session via scripts/gmaps_verify.js (Google Maps rendered listing, rawSnippet: 'National General Cleaning Corp \n 5.0 \n Cleaning service'), run twice with two different query phrasings (business name + city, and business name + exact street address), both times landing on the same listing (WM7J+27 Miami Lakes) with statusLine OPEN_LISTED (not closed). The review COUNT of 50 could NOT be independently reconfirmed live in this session: Google Maps' unauthenticated/logged-out panel is genuinely limited (rawSnippet shows only 'Add photos & videos' / 'Write a review' prompts, no review count or review-tab content is exposed without signing in; confirmed by explicitly clicking into the 'reviews' button and re-reading the page, which still returned no count). No third-party aggregator (Birdeye, Yelp, Angi, Nextdoor, Thumbtack) has an indexed profile for this specific business that could independently corroborate a review count. The 50-review figure is carried over from the task brief, which states it was observed directly in the Google Maps local pack during this run's earlier discovery pass (a step that, unlike this research pass, was signed into a view that shows the count). Flagged transparently rather than silently treated as independently re-verified.
social_proof_note: No verbatim Google reviews with author names could be retrieved (see rating_source: Maps' logged-out view exposes no review text, and no aggregator citing this business's Google reviews exists). Per pipeline rule, using social_proof.modo = 'razones' (3 real-evidence reason cards) instead of fabricating testimonial quotes.
own_site_check: nationalgeneralcleaning.com: curl through the sandbox proxy returned exit 56 / 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 502' (does not resolve/connect). nationalgeneralcleaningcorp.com (the domain claimed by the miamidirections.com aggregator and echoed in some search-summary text): curl timed out after 8s with no response (exit 28), confirming it does not serve a live site either. The only 'website' associated with this business anywhere is https://national-general-cleaning-corp.business.site/ (listed as their website on the BBB profile) -- this is a Google Business Site, a free subdomain of Google's own site builder (business.site), which per pipeline rules explicitly does NOT count as a website propio (same category as square.site/glossgenius.com subdomains). It was fetched directly regardless (curl, browser UA) and returns HTTP 404 -- the Google Site itself is unpublished/broken, so even as a platform subdomain it isn't live. Google Maps live listing also shows an 'Add website' prompt (websiteOnMaps: null), meaning Google itself has no website on file for this Business Profile. has_own_site: false, confirmed via 3 independent checks.
instagram_bio: Commercial Services / Guaranteed Services / 100% Quality / Facebook: National General Cleaning Corp / Twitter: @NationalCorp / Contact us: (786) 718-2426
instagram_bio_source: The direct Instagram profile fetch (both the Railway ig-photo-service and a direct Playwright/Chrome scrape from this sandbox, scripts/ig_scrape_fixed.js) only exposes image URLs and their auto-generated alt text, not the bio text itself. The bio text above was recovered from a Google web-search results summary that quoted the profile page's own meta description verbatim ('National General Cleaning Corp (@nationalgeneralcleaning) on Instagram has a bio that reads: ...'), matching the account's real handle, follower/post counts (53 followers, 51 following, 85 posts) and phone number exactly. Used because it directly confirms the 'Commercial Services' positioning that the photo evidence (warehouse deep-clean, facility floor scrubbing) already pointed to.
instagram_note: Real, active, public account (53 followers, 51 following, 85 posts spanning July 2025-July 2026), confirmed via two independent methods that returned the identical set of 12 most-recently-visible posts: (1) the Railway ig-photo-service, and (2) a direct Playwright/Chrome scrape of instagram.com from this sandbox (scripts/ig_scrape_fixed.js, succeeded on a later attempt after IG's burst rate-limit on this IP cooled down; further attempts to click into Highlights or scroll for older posts were then re-rate-limited (HTTP 429 / net::ERR_HTTP_RESPONSE_CODE_FAILURE) and abandoned per the 'max 2 attempts, move on' rule). This account is NOT a dedicated business portfolio: of the 12 visible posts, only 1 (a 'Warehouse Transformation' graphic combining 3 real before/during/after photos of a warehouse floor deep-clean with 'DEEP CLEAN - SCRUB - SHINE' text and the phone number) is real cleaning-work content; the other 11 are personal/family content (a stylized photo of a child, a flower bouquet, home-cooked meals across several posts, grilling sausages, and a July 4th marketing graphic that is text/branding only, no real photo). This is consistent with a small owner-operated crew running one shared personal+business account, not a marketing-managed brand account.
facebook_note: Confirmed as a real, existing page via web search (title 'National General Cleaning Corp | Miami Lakes FL', matches business name/city exactly) and it is also the exact Facebook page named in the business's own Instagram bio. Content could NOT be read: every fetch attempt (curl with facebookexternalhit/1.1, Facebot, WhatsApp and a full Chrome User-Agent; and WebFetch directly) was redirected to Facebook's login wall (HTTP 302 to facebook.com/login/... on the root page, and to the login form directly on /photos), for every path tried (the /p/ vanity URL and the raw numeric ID facebook.com/100063885917602). No about text, hours, or photos could be extracted.
twitter_x_note: Named in the business's own Instagram bio ('Twitter: @NationalCorp') and matches the task brief. WebFetch returned HTTP 402 Payment Required when attempting to read it; not used as a data source beyond confirming its existence as a real, named channel.
services_note: The business's own Instagram bio literally says 'Commercial Services' (not residential), and every piece of real photo evidence found is commercial/facility work: a warehouse floor deep-clean (their own Instagram post, text overlay 'WAREHOUSE TRANSFORMATION / DEEP CLEAN - SCRUB - SHINE') and a floor-scrubbing/buffing machine actively working a commercial tile floor (the one photo on their Google Business Profile). BBB and Google Maps both list the generic category 'Cleaning Services' / 'Cleaning service' (Google Maps does not use a more specific category like 'House cleaning service' here). No price list or detailed service menu exists anywhere (no own website, no booking platform, BBB/Google/business.site all lack one). Given this, the site describes the business honestly as a commercial/facility cleaning and floor-care company (matching their own bio's positioning), without inventing a residential house-cleaning offering that no evidence supports.

photos.verified_with_file: All 6 files in assets/raw/ (hero.jpg, about-1.jpg, about-2.jpg, gallery-after.jpg, gallery-before.jpg, logo.jpg) confirmed as valid decodable JPEGs via the `file` command.
photos.count_note: 5 distinct real, non-stock, own-work photos meet the hard minimum (hero + about-1 + about-2 + gallery-after + gallery-before). This is a genuinely thin set for a business whose main public channel is a personal-mixed Instagram account with only 1 real work post and a Google Business Profile with only 1 photo; two of the five (about-1 and the two gallery crops) are small (155x237) because they are crops of a single already-compressed Instagram image, and about-2 is 150x150. Resolution is honestly limited but every image is real, decodable, and depicts the company's own work (not stock, not another account, not a graphic-only text card).

palette_note: Clean azure/cornflower blue, base light-v2. Hue 215 is a noticeably cooler, more azure blue than both, reads as clean/corporate/trustworthy, fitting a commercial facility-cleaning company.
